dedupe_keys.name: mozambique road data for travel time maps

description: Mozambique Road Data for Travel Time Maps is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Data for Children Collaborative with UNICEF and University of Edinburgh. School of Geosciences. A polyline shapefile dataset containing roads merged from two source datasets (1) Open street map and (2) MapwithAI project. Used in the creation of travel time estimates in mozambique. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher Data for Children Collaborative with UNICEF and University of Edinburgh. School of Geosciences. Its tags are least-cost-path, children travel time, travel time, health access, health utilization. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
